findings.summary: The new header sanitizer keeps only \x09, \x20-\x7E and \x80-\xFF, so characters above U+00FF (CJK, emoji) are silently dropped from header values instead of being sent or rejected.

Header injection no longer throws: values containing CR or LF are now silently stripped (e.g. 'bad\nvalue' becomes 'badvalue') instead of raising 'Invalid character in header content', which will break callers and tests expecting the error.

NO_PROXY loopback aliasing makes localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 bypass the proxy interchangeably, which breaks deliberate proxying of 127.0.0.1 (e.g. SSH tunnels). It also covers only those three names, so 127.0.0.2 is treated inconsistently.
